title.narrative: Support to Nat'l Program for Sub-National Democratic Development, NP-SNDD, 2013

description.narrative: Stöd till det kambodjanska dentraliseringsprogrammet och dess genomförandeplan, IP3, under 2013. Insatsen syftar främst till att bygga upp och stärka de lokala fokvalda strukturerna på distriksnivå och därmed långsiktigt förbättra servicen till medborgarna samt stärka möjligheterna till ansvarsutkrävande samt folkligt deltagande i lokala beslutsprocesser.

Support to the decentralization process in Cambodia and its implementation plan (IP3)during 2013. The contribution aim at strengthening the sub-national level, especially the district/municipalities and by doing that, improving social service delivery, accountability mechanisms and civic engagement in local decision-making processes.

sector.narrative: Decentralisation and support to subnational government

description.narrative: The objective was to provide support to the decentralisation reform in Cambodia through the National Programme for Sub-National Democratic Development. The contribution supported the IP3 1 phase, including support to policy and capacity development, providing the basis for the decentralisation of services and local democratic development.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
